notes: Korea has no DST, so utcOffset is a fixed +09:00 used to build wall-clock times.
lookaheadMinutes: how early before an away-window starts the day status is set (handles afternoon 반차 on a morning run).
meetings.enabled: also read each connected user's own calendar and show 회의 중 during a meeting. Set false to disable.
meetings.lookaheadMinutes: how early before a meeting starts to show 회의 중 (keep small).
meetings.requireAttendeeOrOnline: only count events with another attendee or an online-meeting link (skips solo focus-time blocks).
Priority: 연차/반차/외근 always win; 재택 yields to 회의 중 during the meeting.
Set dryRun true (or run the workflow with dry_run) to log intended changes without touching Slack.
